svg.title: Attribution: observed costs and questions the records cannot answer

g.text: Each row has a different scope. These quantities cannot be added into a total project loss.
62.90 ms per inventory; 1,619.82 ms per law gate. Corrected paired experiment, one host.
46m16s duplicate job occupancy on one candidate; 128m10s before one wallet job started.
GitHub's October 19 outage is documented. It cannot explain waits on October 16–17.
Intentional sabotage, selective model access, anti-crypto targeting, total lost workdays or dollars.
Needed: attributable decisions, matched tasks/accounts, entitlement logs, labor and billing records.
Missing evidence is not zero harm. The local guardrail-pattern search covers only one conversation snapshot.
